prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web product design decision comp, 1536×1024 landscape
Primary request: Design one shippable-looking Athena desktop workspace titled "Evidence Desk · Verification Lab". Athena is an evidence-first intelligent testing work platform. This is a straight-on full browser application screen, not a physical laboratory, not concept art.

Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed desktop web application canvas. Warm gray laboratory record paper #F3F0E8 as the base, with very subtle fine coordinate grid lines. Graphite #1E2728 for text and structure, oxidized teal #0E6F68 for verified/active states, amber #C88716 for review/attention, vermilion #B23A2B for failure/candidate-risk. Use thin brushed-aluminum divider bars, numbered archival seals, hairline rules, square corners or only 2–4 px radius. No gradients.

Composition/framing: Exact 1536×1024 desktop aspect ratio. Dense but calm professional information architecture with three columns beneath a compact top bar.
1) Left column, about 23% width: "来源与需求样本" shelf. Show compact source records: "REQ-142 结账失败重试", "支付服务设计 v3", "checkout.feature", each with revision/status metadata such as "r17 · 已就绪". Make it feel like an indexed evidence sample rack, not a file-card toy.
2) Center column, about 52% width: the complete verification chain across the top: "需求 → 用例 → 脚本 → 评审 → 执行 → RCA". Every future-stage block — 用例、脚本、评审、执行、RCA — must carry a clearly visible identical stamp reading exactly "目标态 · 合成示例". The center workbench focuses on REQ-142 and shows a traceable flow: requirement excerpt; compact test-case rows including "TC-04 弱网重试"; a small real code-like Playwright script panel; deterministic checks with labels such as "Schema 8/8", "Lint 通过", "选择器 待核验"; and execution summary "Run #184 · 12/14 通过". Embed a small contextual Knowledge Chat panel inside this chain, not as a separate generic chat page: prompt "为什么 TC-04 需要幂等校验？", a concise grounded response, and citations "[REQ-142 §3.2]" and "[ADR-19]".
3) Right column, about 25% width: "证据保管链", a vertical custody ledger connecting "需求 revision r17", "生成记录 gen-298", "评审签核 apv-02", "运行证据 run-184/a1", and "RCA 候选 rca-07". Use explicit state chips "事实", "候选", "已验证", "待评审" so facts, suggestions, candidates, and verified results are unmistakably different. Every target-only record must also carry the exact stamp "目标态 · 合成示例".

Top bar text: "Athena", "Evidence Desk", "项目 Checkout Revamp", "角色视图 QA". Add one highly visible master disclosure strip near the page title reading exactly "目标态 · 合成示例｜测试链路能力尚未交付". Do not claim the target capabilities are live.

Style/medium: realistic high-fidelity enterprise product UI, meticulous editorial/industrial information design, akin a verification dossier and controlled laboratory logbook. Crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, tabular numerals, precise alignment, strong hierarchy, generous enough spacing for readability. The visual metaphor is validation discipline and evidence custody, never literal lab equipment.

Text (verbatim, render accurately and sparingly): "Athena"; "Evidence Desk"; "目标态 · 合成示例｜测试链路能力尚未交付"; "来源与需求样本"; "需求 → 用例 → 脚本 → 评审 → 执行 → RCA"; "目标态 · 合成示例"; "证据保管链"; "Knowledge Chat"; "为什么 TC-04 需要幂等校验？"; "Run #184 · 12/14 通过"; "事实"; "候选"; "已验证"; "待评审".

Constraints: One single complete desktop app screen; hierarchy must be instantly understandable; use only a few accurate UI labels; distinguish current evidence/knowledge inputs from target-stage synthetic examples; all target capabilities have an obvious exact "目标态 · 合成示例" label; preserve practical clickable controls and realistic data density; no watermark; no company logos; no fictional customer metrics.

Avoid: beakers, microscopes, flasks, literal laboratory props, ancient Greece, Athena goddess imagery, generic AI chat homepage, giant chat composer, glassmorphism, gradients, neon cyberpunk, glowing effects, floating cards, excessive rounded cards, pill-heavy design, purple SaaS palette, isometric art, stock illustrations, marketing landing page, decorative dashboards, illegible tiny text.
